edits.text: 1. EFFECTIVE DATE; PAYMENT. The effective date of this Agreement is the date of the last signature below. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT—TO BE AGREED] within [NUMBER—TO BE AGREED] days after the effective date.

2. RELEASE. Any release by Plaintiff shall become effective only upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the full settlement amount in cleared funds. The scope of the release remains to be agreed and will be set forth in the final execution version of this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that a party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers, as required by law or legal process, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party disclosing settlement terms to its advisers shall inform them of their confidential nature.
